# Conalytic

> Conalytic is a marketing analytics platform with three built-in tools: Conversational Analytics (Chats), KPIs Tracker, and Report Builder. Connect Google and Meta ad accounts via OAuth, then query data in plain English, track KPI goals, or generate HTML report decks.

## Products

- [Conversational Analytics](https://www.conalytic.com/products/conversational-analytics): Chat with live GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, GTM, and Meta Ads data. Scoped per conversation with inline charts and tables. App sidebar label: **Chats**.
- [KPIs Tracker](https://www.conalytic.com/products/kpis-tracker): Goal-based KPI monitoring for GA4, Search Console, and Google Ads with on-track / at-risk / off-track status and six-month history. App sidebar label: **KPIs**.
- [Report Builder](https://www.conalytic.com/products/report-builder): Multi-platform HTML presentation decks with executive summary, platform sections, cross-source insights, optional AI narratives, and action plans. App sidebar label: **Reports**.

## App & signup

- Marketing site: https://www.conalytic.com
- Product app (login): https://chat.conalytic.com/login
- Sign up: https://chat.conalytic.com/signup

## Integrations (OAuth)

Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads (connection supported).

## Pricing model

Free signup with included tokens on Pro; usage-metered chat and AI report insights; optional PayPal top-ups. KPI Tracker uses live API data without LLM token metering.
